printedReportCandidate.englishTranslation:
Ahmad related to us. ‘Abdullah ibn Wahb related to us. Ibn Jurayj informed us. Ayyub said: And I heard Hafsah bint Sirin say: Umm ‘Atiyyah, may Allah be pleased with her, related to us:

They had arranged the hair on the head of the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, into three braids. They undid it, then washed it, then arranged it into three braids.
